as_told.title: Levenda: DeLonge pointed to the Prometheus myth

plain: Peter Levenda, a researcher and writer, says that around 2015, while working with the musician Tom DeLonge, they got a long email from one of DeLonge's most trusted advisers asking how much they really knew about Greek mythology. The hint, as the story is framed, pointed toward Prometheus, the Greek figure who stole fire from the gods for humans. If true, insiders would be suggesting that ancient myths hold clues about contact with non-human beings.
